sections.name: Definitions: what is X
sections.intent: what is, meaning, definition, explained simply
sections.format: A 40-60 word definition at the top (the featured-snippet answer), then how it works, an example, related terms.

place.title: What is {concept}? Meaning and example
links: the blog post that explains it in depth
the board pages that report it

sections.name: Concepts in depth: how does X work, X vs Y
sections.intent: how does it work, explained, guide, examples, vs, which is better
sections.format: An explainer post: the idea, a diagram, a worked example, trade-offs, what engineers report.

place.title: {concept} explained: how it works and when to use it

sections.name: Model versus model
sections.intent: vs, or, difference between, better than, compared to
sections.format: A side-by-side table: a score per category with the reports behind it, price and specs, and a short answer per category.

place.title: {model} vs {model_b}: what engineers report, price and specs

sections.name: Model lookup: a model's name, price, limits
sections.intent: the name alone, pricing, context window, specs, release date, open source
sections.format: A spec card at the top (price, context, features), then what engineers report, then FAQs.

place.title: {model}: price, context window and what engineers report

sections.name: How-to: using a model's API
sections.intent: how to use, how to, tutorial, getting started, example
sections.format: A tutorial: numbered steps, a working code sample, common errors at the end.

place.title: How to use the {model} API in {language}

sections.name: How-to: doing a job with AI
sections.intent: how to, with ai, step by step
sections.format: A tutorial post: the steps, which model engineers used for it, what went wrong.

place.title: How to {task} with AI
links: the model picker for this job

sections.name: Troubleshooting: errors and problems
sections.intent: error, fix, not working, why is X slow
sections.format: Cause and fix: what the error means, the fix, how to prevent it.

place.title: {model} {error}: what it means and how to fix it
links: the developer guide for the model

sections.name: Opinion: what people say
sections.format: First-hand experiences, quoted and linked, most recent first.

place.title: {model}: what people say after using it

sections.name: Opinion: does it work
sections.intent: is X good, worth it, problems, does it actually work
sections.format: Counted reports: how many engineers reported it working or failing, at what.

sections.name: Selection: best model for a job
sections.intent: best, top, which should I use
sections.format: A short list with reasons, from what engineers reported for that job; a cheaper option beside each.

place.title: Best AI model for {job}, from what engineers report

sections.name: Alternatives to a model
sections.intent: alternatives, cheaper than, instead of, like
sections.format: What engineers moved to instead, and why: cheaper, faster, open.

sections.name: Listings: lists and new releases
sections.format: A filterable list, newest first where the query says new.

sections.name: Cost and size: how many tokens, will it fit
sections.intent: how many tokens, cost per, will it fit, how much
sections.format: A calculator: paste text, get tokens and cost on every model.

sections.name: Changes: updates, deprecations, drift
sections.intent: did X get worse, deprecated, what's new, changelog
sections.format: A dated log: what changed, when, and what engineers reported after.

sections.name: Migration: switching models
sections.intent: migrate, switch, move from, breaking changes
sections.format: What breaks, what the price change is, what engineers reported after switching.

sections.name: Prompts for a model or job
sections.format: Prompts that worked, per model and per job, copyable.

sections.name: Benchmarks: scores and leaderboards
sections.format: The figures engineers reported on that benchmark, per model, with the post each came from.

place.title: {benchmark} scores: what engineers measured
links: the glossary entry for the benchmark

sections.name: Brand and category terms
sections.format: The front door: what the board is and the three ways in (compare, pick, browse).

place.title: Best AI model for the job, from what engineers report
place.h1: Find the best AI model for the job
